what_this_is: Product-side timing for Maria's four steps, from one client over the internet, plus a fixed checklist. It does NOT measure how long a person takes without the product.

checklist.check: lists the known related disease (Niemann-Pick type C)
that link has a mechanism reason backed by stored claims
at least one patient group with a registry link
at least one matched study with a source URL
at least one researcher with their papers
an evidence brief exists and cites stored claims
every claim the brief cites opens with its quote and source URL
